message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel scatter plot comparing A-mem and Base embedding locations across Dialogue 1 and Dialogue 2.","description":"A pair of scatter plots, each with blue dots for “A-mem” and salmon-red dots for “Base,” identified by a legend in the upper-left corner. Both panels have numeric x- and y-axes but no axis titles or connecting lines. Dialogue 1 has ticks at about −20, −10, 0, 10, and 20 on both axes. The blue points form several relatively concentrated groups, including a large lower-middle group and smaller groups in the upper-middle and upper-right; the red points are more broadly dispersed across the plot. Dialogue 2 has x ticks from about −20 to 20 and y ticks from about −20 to 30. Its blue points form especially distinct groups near the upper middle and lower left, with fewer points scattered between them; the red points are more diffuse across the panel. Thus, in both dialogues A-mem appears more clustered than Base, particularly in Dialogue 2. The chart_values are representative approximate read-offs of visible dots, not an exhaustive digitization; each value is an estimated y-coordinate at the listed
